audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Headbutt as the read but gives no actual cooldown number (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and never states that Alistar's Trample (E) and Triumphant Roar (P) can interrupt Pyke's Bone Skewer (Q) channel, or that Trample's stun autoattack has a wind-up tell.
audit.why: Q is an interruptible channel — any Alistar CC (Pulverize knockup, Trample stun, Headbutt) cancels it, and Trample's stacking auto-reset gives a visible wind-up before the point-and-click stun lands.

edits.before: - Alistar Headbutt: matchup-defining — The headbutt-pulverize combo starts every play — respect flash range while it is up. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Ghostwater Dive answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Headbutt (W) is 14/13/12/11/10s — the combo starter, respect flash range while it's up. - Trample (E), 12-10s, and Triumphant Roar (P) both cancel your Q channel; commit it after his CC is spent. - Your W Ghostwater Dive answers one disaster per its own 14-10s cooldown.

edits.before: Q-threat the cover, E the gap, X the threshold — the chain pays your whole team.
edits.after: Trample's stun auto has a wind-up tell — step off it, then E him back into your team.

edits.before: Fishing visibly at half HP — Pyke's health bar is a rumor only fog can keep.
edits.after: Landing Q on Alistar wastes the pull — save the threat for his squishier ADC instead.
